features: 260W 5.1 CHANNEL SURROUND SOUND: Delivers powerful, cinema-quality audio through a dedicated subwoofer and satellite speakers for a truly immersive home theatre experience.
BLUETOOTH 5.3 CONNECTIVITY: Stream wireless audio seamlessly with the latest Bluetooth 5.3 technology, offering a stable connection up to 10 metres range.
HDMI ARC & MULTIPLE INPUTS: Connect effortlessly to your TV via HDMI ARC, or use AUX and USB ports for versatile compatibility with a wide range of devices.
COMPLETE 5.1 HOME THEATRE SETUP: Includes 1 soundbar, 1 subwoofer with a 6.5-inch driver, and 2 satellite speakers for rich, room-filling surround sound.
EASY CONTROLS & SETUP: Manage your audio with a remote or push-button controls; simple assembly lets you place, connect, and enjoy your system in minutes.
